subDid.description: Per-title path-based DID, e.g. did:web:gameka.etzhayyim.com:game:quarry-rune. Auto-served by host-sdk did.json (ADR-0023).

playUrl.description: Public play URL, e.g. https://game-play.etzhayyim.com/{slug}. Resolves to a kami-app shell that loads the latest -built artefact for this title.

version.description: Title version string, defaults to v1. Subsequent revise iterations bump this.

profileUri.description: AT URI of the sub-DID's app.bsky.actor.profile record. Holds displayName=title, description=brief+playUrl, disclaimer (AI-Agent unofficial), and avatar reference. Created in publishGame.bpmn Task_RegisterProfile before the launch post so the post lands on a populated timeline.

publishPostUri.description: AT URI of the launch announcement post (app.bsky.feed.post by subDid).

avatarDataUri.description: data:image/png;base64,… of the procedural identicon rendered from slug + biome by gameka.avatar.render (ADR 2604250900 P10). Used by the playtest shell as <link rel="icon"> and og:image. Empty for pre-P10 titles.
